source_prompt: An elderly female alchemist with gray hair in an updo and ornate golden headpiece, wearing green and purple robes, stands reading a large open magical book that has a glowing red rose on the pages. She is in a wooden alchemy laboratory filled with shelves of colorful potion bottles, hanging lanterns, and dried herbs. In the foreground a table covered with a white cloth holds a large cracked bowl spilling purple liquid, a lit red candle, a golden coin with the number 25, and a large purple quill. A glowing blue magical portal and red poppies are visible on the wall behind her, along with a decorative banner showing a purple moth.
